use_default_doc_key: use the DEFAULT_DOC_KEY constant to reference supported document file types like pdf, png, and jpeg
use_default_question_key: use the DEFAULT_QUESTION_KEY constant to reference standard question and query column names
use_default_answer_key: use the DEFAULT_ANSWER_KEY constant to reference standard answer and answers column names
use_default_doc_feat: use the DEFAULT_DOC_FEAT ImageFeatureInfo instance for grayscale image input with standard document keys
use_default_question_feat: use the DEFAULT_QUESTION_FEAT FeatureInfo instance to map question and query input keys in a dataset
